content: Finance » Payment Gateways » Additional Settings » Billing Address Countries Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047893 This section controls the active and featured countries displayed on paid checkout pages. Here it is possible to modify the countries that display in paid sig- up forms and choose which countries are displayed or not: In order to select which countries to display on the section above, go to Finance » Payment Gateways » Additional Settings » Billing Address Countries A new page will open where the Active, Featured and Not Active Countries can be selected: Country Status Types Not Active (The country is not going to display as an option on the Sign-Up / Checkout Page) Active (The country is going to display as an option on the Sign Up / Checkout Page) Featured (The country will show up first and so on, on the list) For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
